title: The Impact of Trade on Economic Prosperity
research_question: How does the volume of international trade affect a country's economic prosperity? Specifically, we investigate the causal relationship between trade volume and GDP per capita, using geographic distance as an instrumental variable for trade volume.
data_description: The dataset contains 400 observations with columns y (log GDP per capita), x (trade volume), z (geographic distance), and controls (various economic indicators). The sample includes data from multiple countries over recent years.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use geographic distance as an instrument for trade volume to isolate its impact on GDP per capita.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Increased trade volume has a significant negative effect on log GDP per capita.
